title: The best task management software for short-term rentals (2026)
summary: Seven STR task management tools compared: which turn guest messages into tasks, route them, collect photo proof and close the loop with the guest.
body_markdown:
**The best task management software for short-term rentals is the one that creates the task for you. A guest writes "the hot tub is cold," and the right tool turns that into a task with the listing, the photo and a due date, assigns it to the right person, and tells the guest when it's fixed. Most tools on the market do one or two of those steps. This guide compares seven of them, step by step, so you can see where each one hands the work back to you.**


We make ProhostAI, so we're one of the tools on this list. We've tried to describe every product the way its own customers would, and to say plainly where a competitor is the better fit. Pricing was checked against each vendor's public pages in November 2026. When a vendor doesn't publish a price, we say so instead of guessing.


## Key takeaways


- **The job has four steps:** turn a message or event into a task, route it to the right person, get proof it's done, and close the loop with the guest. A tool that skips a step leaves that step to you.
- **Operations-first tools** (Breezeway, Operto Teams) are strongest on field work: checklists, inspections, maintenance and inventory. Guest messaging is an add-on or a separate module.
- **PMS-built-in task managers** (Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable) create tasks from the booking calendar well. Tasks that start from a *guest message* usually still need a person to create them.
- **AI-first tools** (ProhostAI, Conduit) read guest messages and reviews and create the task themselves, then message the guest when the work is done.
- **If you have a field team of 10+ people and heavy inspections, an operations platform is worth it.** If most of your tasks start in the inbox, pick a tool that reads the inbox.


## How we compared them


Every task in a rental business starts in one of three places:


1. **The calendar.** A checkout creates a turnover clean. A long stay creates a mid-stay clean.
2. **A guest message.** "The Wi-Fi is down." "There's no coffee." "The door code isn't working."
3. **A review or inspection.** "The shower drain was slow." A cleaner's photo of a broken lamp.


Calendar tasks are a solved problem; almost every tool on this list does them. The difference is in the second and third sources, which are where most of the *unplanned* work comes from. So for each tool we asked four questions:


- **Message to task:** does a guest message become a task without a person retyping it?
- **Routing:** does the task reach the right cleaner, handyman or teammate automatically?
- **Proof:** does the person doing the work send photos and a checklist back?
- **Guest loop:** does the guest hear that it's fixed without someone writing to them?

## 1. ProhostAI


**Best for:** hosts and property managers whose tasks mostly start in the guest inbox, and who want the same tool to handle messaging, cleanings and the team.


ProhostAI reads every guest message and review, from Airbnb directly or from every channel your PMS connects. When a guest reports a problem, it creates the task on its own: the listing, the reservation, the guest's words and photos, a priority and a suggested assignee. Your team gets notified on web or mobile, works through the checklist and adds photos, and an[AI Workflow](https://prohost.ai/ai-agent-workflows) can message the guest the moment the task is marked complete. Review comments like "the shower drain was slow" become maintenance tasks the same way.


Turnover cleanings are scheduled from checkouts and auto-assigned to cleaners, and AI Workflows let you write your own rules in plain language, such as "when a guest reports a lockout, text the on-call teammate and create an urgent task."


- **Strengths:** message-to-task and review-to-task without a person in the middle; guest messaging, cleanings, team chat and tasks in one place; works on top of Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu and Beds24, or directly with Airbnb.
- **Trade-offs:** lighter than Breezeway on inventory and formal inspection reports. If you run dozens of inspectors with detailed property-care audits, an operations platform goes deeper.
- **Pricing:** the all-in-one plan is $15 per property per month (minimum $30), with messaging, cleanings, tasks and AI included. See[plans](https://prohost.ai/plans) .


More:[AI task management](https://prohost.ai/features/tasks) ,[cleanings](https://prohost.ai/features/cleanings) .


## 2. Breezeway


**Best for:** property managers with a large field team who need inspections, maintenance tracking and inventory as much as cleanings.


Breezeway is a property care and operations platform. Its core is task scheduling and automation, mobile checklists with photos, inspections, maintenance work orders, inventory, and owner reports. It also schedules and pays cleaners. Breezeway has added guest-facing products: AI guest messaging, digital welcome books and upsells in its Guest Experience plans, and a **Concierge** add-on that replies to guests with AI and turns guest inquiries into tracked tasks.


- **Strengths:** deep field operations, detailed checklists and inspections, mature mobile app for cleaners and technicians.
- **Trade-offs:** the guest side is an add-on to an operations product, and the plans that combine both are quoted rather than published. Many teams pair Breezeway with a separate AI messaging tool.
- **Pricing:** free for your first property. Host Essentials is listed from $19.99 per unit per month, with messaging and other modules as add-ons. Operations Pro and the combined plans are quoted.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Breezeway](https://prohost.ai/vs/breezeway) .


## 3. Operto Teams


**Best for:** professional managers who want rules-based housekeeping and maintenance scheduling, and who are happy running guest messaging in a separate module.


Operto Teams is the current name of VRScheduler. It generates tasks from reservations using rules you set, shows them on a drag-and-drop calendar, and gives staff checklists with photos. Guest messaging lives in a separate product, Operto Guest, which sends scheduled messages by SMS, push and email.


- **Strengths:** flexible scheduling rules, strong housekeeping and maintenance coverage, long track record with professional managers.
- **Trade-offs:** messages and tasks live in two modules, so a guest-reported problem still needs a person to turn it into a task.
- **Pricing:** not published; ask for a quote.


## 4. Hostaway


**Best for:** Hostaway customers who want tasks inside their PMS and are comfortable creating message-driven tasks by hand.


Hostaway is a PMS and channel manager with a built-in task manager. It creates cleaning, maintenance and inspection tasks, and staff work through checklists in the Hostaway mobile app. Hostaway also offers AI replies in its inbox, with optional rules that send automatically.


- **Strengths:** tasks and reservations in the same system; good calendar-based automation.
- **Trade-offs:** when a guest reports a problem, a teammate usually reads the message and creates the task. Closing the loop with the guest is manual.
- **Pricing:** not published; Hostaway quotes by portfolio.


If you use Hostaway, you don't have to replace it to get AI tasks: ProhostAI[connects to Hostaway](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hostaway) and creates tasks from the conversations it syncs.


## 5. Guesty


**Best for:** larger property managers already on Guesty who want tasks and AI in their PMS.


Guesty is a full property management platform with task management, a staff app for photos and notes, and AI agents that can draft replies and create tasks from guest messages. Guesty Lite serves smaller hosts; Guesty Pro and Enterprise are quoted.


- **Strengths:** one system for reservations, channels, payments and operations; AI features growing quickly.
- **Trade-offs:** the depth comes with a heavier setup, and the best AI and operations features are on the quoted tiers.
- **Pricing:** Lite has published per-listing pricing for small portfolios; Pro is quoted.


ProhostAI also[works with Guesty](https://prohost.ai/integrations/guesty) .


## 6. Hospitable


**Best for:** small and mid-size hosts who want simple calendar-based tasks for free or close to it.


Hospitable creates tasks from check-ins, checkouts and mid-stay events and sends them to cleaners by email, SMS or calendar feed, with photos of finished jobs. It includes a cleaner marketplace. Its free Essentials plan includes tasks and a limited number of AI-suggested replies; the paid plans add automated messaging, AI drafts and a Tasks Manager.


- **Strengths:** very easy to set up; free starting point; tasks on every plan.
- **Trade-offs:** tasks come from the calendar, not from what guests write, so problem reports still need a person.
- **Pricing:** free Essentials plan; paid tiers are listed on Hospitable's site.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Hospitable AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/hospitable-ai) . ProhostAI also[connects to Hospitable](https://prohost.ai/integrations/hospitable) .


## 7. Conduit


**Best for:** larger operators who want an AI agent platform with phone, messaging and tasks, and who can work with a higher per-unit price.


Conduit is an AI agent platform for hospitality. Its agents read guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo, WhatsApp, SMS, email and phone, create tasks with photos, and send work orders to cleaners by SMS or email with accept and decline links. Task updates can trigger messages back to the guest.


- **Strengths:** strong message-to-task automation; covers voice as well as text.
- **Trade-offs:** cleaning and maintenance dispatch is on its top published tier, priced well above most tools on this list.
- **Pricing:** Conduit publishes per-unit plans: Messaging at $18, Guest at $30 (adds upsells) and Full Suite at $48 (adds cleaning and maintenance dispatch) per unit per month, plus a Startup plan at $899 a month for up to 25 units (checked November 2026).


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Conduit](https://prohost.ai/vs/conduit) .


## Should you keep your operations app and connect it?


Often, yes. If your cleaners already live in Breezeway or Turno and it works, don't rip it out. The bigger gain usually comes from the step before the operations app: someone has to notice the problem in a guest message and create the task. An AI tool that reads the inbox removes that step, and you can keep your field app for the work itself.


The case for one tool is simpler: when messaging and tasks live together, the guest's own words and photos are attached to the task, and a workflow can tell the guest the moment it's closed. Our data shows what fast follow-through is worth: hosts who switched on ProhostAI saw their guest communication rating rise from 4.77 to 4.86 ([the full study](https://prohost.ai/blog/does-ai-make-better-hosts) ).


## How to choose


- **Under 20 listings, simple turnovers:** Hospitable's free plan or Turno for cleaning, plus an AI inbox if guests message a lot.
- **20–200 listings, most problems reported by guests:** an AI-first tool like ProhostAI that turns messages and reviews into tasks.
- **200+ listings with a dedicated maintenance team and formal inspections:** an operations platform like Breezeway or Operto Teams, with AI messaging on top.
- **Already on a PMS you like:** try its task manager first; if guest-reported issues keep slipping, add an AI layer rather than switching PMS.


## Frequently asked questions


**What is task management software for short-term rentals?**
It's software that creates, assigns and tracks the work behind each stay: turnover cleanings, maintenance, inspections, restocking and guest requests. Good tools connect to your booking calendar and your guest inbox so tasks are created automatically.


**Can AI create maintenance tasks from guest messages?**
Yes. Tools like ProhostAI and Conduit read each guest message, recognize a problem report ("the AC is leaking"), and create a task with the listing, reservation and photos attached. They can also create tasks from review comments.


**Do I need a separate app for my cleaners?**
Not necessarily. ProhostAI, Breezeway, Hostaway, Guesty and Hospitable all give cleaners a mobile app or a link to see their tasks, work through checklists and upload photos.


**Is there free task management software for Airbnb hosts?**
Hospitable's Essentials plan includes tasks for free, Breezeway is free for one property, and Turno has a free tier for cleaning scheduling.


**What's the difference between a PMS task manager and an operations platform?**
A PMS task manager creates tasks from reservations inside the same system you use for bookings. An operations platform like Breezeway goes deeper on field work, with inspections, inventory, work orders and owner reports, and connects to your PMS.
